u_generator_levenskracht_rea.Generator: Life force. Responds from the gut. Here to find the right work.
u_generator_levenskracht_rea.Manifesting Generator: Accelerated Generator. Several paths at once. Inform before you act.
u_generator_levenskracht_rea.Projector: Guide. Sees systems and people clearly. Waits for an invitation to be recognized.
u_generator_levenskracht_rea.Manifestor: Initiator. Starts things. Inform before you move.
u_generator_levenskracht_rea.Reflector: Mirror of the community. Waits a lunar cycle for big decisions.

u_generator_het_sacrale_als_.Generator:
The Sacral as a compass. The Generator has a defined Sacral center — the only true power source in Human Design. This center does not speak in language but in sounds: "uh-huh" for yes, "mm-mmm" for no.

Aura: open and enveloping. Generators attract what is meant for them.

The pitfall: initiating without response. As soon as a Generator starts something on their own without first responding to something external, frustration arises.
u_generator_het_sacrale_als_.Manifesting Generator:
Accelerated living. An MG combines the responsive power of a Generator with the initiating power of a Manifestor.

Informing as a second layer. On top of the Sacral response, this applies: let people know what you are planning to do.

The pitfall: stopping halfway. MGs like to skip steps, but sometimes leave something half finished where the Sacral response still said yes.
u_generator_het_sacrale_als_.Projector:
Not here to work like the majority. Projectors have no consistent Sacral energy. Their system is designed to see systems — people, processes, dynamics.

The invitation is not a question. An invitation is recognition. Someone who sees you, feels your aura, and makes room for what you have to offer.

Bitterness is the signal. If you offer yourself to someone who hasn't asked you, bitterness follows.

Rest is productive. The Projector aura works during rest — energies are digested, insights ripen.
u_generator_het_sacrale_als_.Manifestor:
Designed to begin. Manifestors are the initiators. They receive impulses from within and set things in motion — without needing an invitation.

Inform, don't explain. Let the people around you know what you are going to do before you do it.

Peace is the signature. When the Manifestor is in their power, an inner peace settles in.
u_generator_het_sacrale_als_.Reflector:
Rare and careful. About 1% of the population. Reflectors have no defined centers at all — they fully mirror their surroundings.

The lunar cycle as authority. For big decisions, take a full 28-day cycle.

Environment is everything. In a good environment the Reflector flourishes.

u_wachten_op_respons_reagere.Wachten op respons:
Respond, don't initiate. The Sacral response comes before thinking. Questions that come from outside activate the Sacral.

Yes-no questions as a tool. For big choices: have someone ask you a clear question and listen to the sound that arises.
u_wachten_op_respons_reagere.Wachten op de Uitnodiging:
Recognition as the key. The invitation is about being seen. Someone notices you and makes room. Only then does your guide come into its own.

Four big invitations in life. Love, career, place of residence, friendship.

Without an invitation: resistance. Even correct advice is rejected when it comes unasked.
u_wachten_op_respons_reagere.Informeren:
One sentence is enough. "I'm going outside." It is not an accounting — it is a signal to the aura around you.

Why informing works. The Manifestor aura is closed and impelling. Without an announcement, others experience the movement as an ambush.
u_wachten_op_respons_reagere.Wachten een maancyclus:
The moon as a metronome. 28 days to let a decision ripen.

Don't withdraw — talk. Talk to different people about the question.

u_sacraal_niet_in_taal_wel_i.Sacraal: Not in language, but in sound. The Sacral answers with "uh-huh" or "mm-mmm" — subtle throat sounds before the mind intervenes.
u_sacraal_niet_in_taal_wel_i.Milt:
Once only and quiet. The Spleen whispers in the now, and does not repeat itself.

Body knowing, not thinking. A direct form of protection by the body.

Practicing stillness. The Spleen is gentle — silence is not a luxury but a tool.
u_sacraal_niet_in_taal_wel_i.Emotioneel:
Truth in the wave. Only when the wave has fully run its course can you have a clear feeling.

Don't decide at the peak or in the trough. Truth lies in the quiet middle.
u_sacraal_niet_in_taal_wel_i.Ego: The willpower speaks. "Do I want this?" is the only relevant question.
u_sacraal_niet_in_taal_wel_i.G-centrum (Zelf-Projected): The truth comes while speaking. Hear yourself talk to know what you know.
u_sacraal_niet_in_taal_wel_i.Mentaal (Environmental): No inner yes-no. The right environment brings clarity.
u_sacraal_niet_in_taal_wel_i.Lunair: See Strategy. For Reflectors, strategy and authority are the same mechanism: the lunar cycle.

app.u_nu_zie_je_welke_centra_bij:
Now you can see which centers are defined for {e1} — {e2} of the 9.

Defined = colored = reliable. This energy is always on, always available. It is who you are, what people can count on you for.

Open = white = receptive. These centers take in the energy of others and become amplifiers. They are also where conditioning can enter — where the not-self works most strongly.

Centers are either permanently on (for your whole life) or permanently open. This does not change.
app.u_een_centrum_wordt_niet_zom:
A center is not defined just like that — it happens through channels. Channels connect two centers, and when both endpoints are active, the energy flows and both centers are on.

{e7}

The color of a channel tells you how it was activated: red = Design (unconscious, the body), black = Personality (conscious, the mind). It is often mixed — then you see both colors in one channel.
app.u_de_64_poorten_zijn_de_numm:
The 64 gates are the numbers around the centers. Each gate corresponds to a hexagram from the I Ching — a theme from the ancient Chinese wisdom system.

A gate is activated when a planet was at that position at your birth (or 88 days before). Two active gates on either side of a channel = channel defined.

You can now see the colored gates light up for {e1}. The light-colored ones stay open.

Red = Design activation, black = Personality, gold = both.

app.u_p_dit_is_de_bodygraph_de_vis:
This is the bodygraph — the visual form in which Human Design works. Nine geometric shapes, connected by lines, with 64 numbers around them.

Right now everything is empty. No color, no activation. This is how everyone is born: a blueprint without content.

The lines you see are the possible connections. The circles are the gates where planetary positions land at birth.
app.u_p_de_negen_geometrische_vorm:
The nine geometric shapes are the centers — nine places in the body where energy is processed.

Each center has a theme: Head (inspiration), Ajna (thinking), Throat (communication), G (identity and direction), Heart (willpower), Sacral (life force), Spleen (intuition), Solar Plexus (emotions), Root (pressure).

In everyone, these nine centers are present. The difference lies in which are defined (get color) and which stay open.
